rows.note: Use this when an outcome is conditional on a factor; it is the all-purpose choice for this sense.

example.english: Our success will depend on whether everyone is willing to cooperate.
example.traditional: 我哋成功唔成功，視乎大家肯唔肯合作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sing4 gung1 m4 sing4 gung1 si6 fu4 daai6 gaa1 hang2 m4 hang2 hap6 zok3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday verb for relying on a person, source, or thing.

example.english: This month, we’ll depend on our credit card to get by.
example.traditional: 今個月我哋要靠張信用卡過日子。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 jyut6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kaau3 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaat1 gwo3 jat6 zi2

rows.note: Use this when depend means trusting someone's word, assurance, or judgment rather than relying on practical help.

example.english: I don’t depend on what this person says.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jan4 gong2 ge3 je5 ngo5 m4 seon3
